sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SOUTHEASTWARD SURGING STRONG POLAR JET /130+ KT 300 MB/ WILL CONTRIBUTE TO CONSIDERABLE LARGE SCALE TROUGH AMPLIFICATION THROUGH TONIGHT ACROSS THE CENTRAL/EASTERN CONUS...WITH THE MAIN PORTION OF THE LONGWAVE TROUGH EVOLVING OVER THE UPPER MIDWEST. MULTI-PHASED SURFACE CYCLOGENESIS WILL OCCUR TODAY ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST AND UPPER/MIDDLE MS VALLEYS...WITH AN EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD MOVING COLD FRONT PROGRESSIVELY INTERCEPTING AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AIRMASS TOWARD THE ARKLATEX/MS VALLEY INTO THIS EVENING...WITH SEVERE TSTMS PROBABLE AS BELOW.

sections.title: ARKLATEX/OZARKS TO LOWER/MIDDLE MS VALLEY
sections.text: WHILE MOISTURE IS INITIALLY LIMITED AWAY FROM THE TX COAST EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT...STEADY MOISTURE TRANSPORT WILL OCCUR NEAR/MORE SO ABOVE THE SURFACE EARLY TODAY IN TANDEM WITH AN INCREASINGLY STRONG SOUTHWESTERLY LOW LEVEL JET. BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON...LOWER TO MIDDLE 60S F SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE EXPECTED TO BECOME WELL ESTABLISHED FROM THE ARKLATEX INTO THE OZARKS/MIDDLE MS VALLEY...WHERE A SURFACE WAVE MAY DEVELOP IN VICINITY OF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG/STEADY HEIGHT FALLS AND A BROADLY DIFFLUENT UPPER JET EXIT REGION OVERSPREADING AN INCREASINGLY MOIST WARM SECTOR WILL LEAD TO STRONG/SEVERE SURFACE BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT TODAY ACROSS THE REGION...PERHAPS AS SOON AS EARLY AFTERNOON OR MORE CERTAINLY BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON. SUCH DEVELOPMENT SHOULD INITIALLY OCCUR ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE OZARKS/PERHAPS FAR EASTERN OK...WHILE EXPANDING SHORTLY THEREAFTER INTO THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY VICINITY AND REMAINDER OF AR AND THE ARKLATEX VICINITY. THIS DEVELOPMENT WILL PRINCIPALLY BE NEAR THE COLD FRONT...ALTHOUGH SOME SEMI-DISCRETE DEVELOPMENT COULD OCCUR AHEAD OF IT ACROSS PORTIONS OF SOUTHERN/EASTERN AR AND NORTHERN LA/NORTHWEST MS WHERE A RELATIVELY MOIST/WEAKLY INHIBIT

sections.title: MIDWEST/OH VALLEY
sections.text: LOWER-TOPPED CONVECTION IS LIKELY TO DEVELOP NEAR THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON WITHIN A KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY AMPLE FORCING FOR ASCENT/VERY STRONG SHEAR. EXPECTATIONS FOR MORE MARGINAL MOISTENING/ANEMIC DESTABILIZATION SHOULD LARGELY LIMIT THE SEVERE POTENTIAL WITH NORTHWARD EXTENT FOR AREAS SUCH AS NORTHEAST MO AND IL/INDIANA. THAT SAID...AT LEAST CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY NONETHELESS BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING. UNANTICIPATED LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING/DESTABILIZATION WITH NORTHWARD EXTENT...EVEN A COUPLED HUNDRED J/KG SBCAPE...WOULD WARRANT NORTHWARD-SPATIAL ADJUSTMENTS OF THE CURRENT SLIGHT RISK ACROSS MORE OF THE REGION. ..GUYER/ROGERS.. 10/17/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE EXIT REGION OF AN INTENSE...MID TO UPPER-TROPOSPHERIC WIND MAXIMUM SITUATED OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL PROGRESS SEWD INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY...CONTRIBUTING TO SIGNIFICANT DEEPENING OF A LARGE-SCALE TROUGH OVER THE CNTRL PART OF THE NATION. AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT FROM LOW PRESSURE OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO SRN HIGH PLAINS WILL STRENGTHEN WHILE SWEEPING SEWD THROUGH THE SRN PLAINS AND OZARK PLATEAU...AND EVENTUALLY THE MID AND LOWER MS VALLEYS. A FRONTAL WAVE ANALYZED OVER NWRN OK AS OF 12Z WILL DEVELOP ESEWD INTO CNTRL AR BY MID AFTERNOON BEFORE DEVELOPING RAPIDLY NNEWD THROUGH THE MID MS VALLEY TONIGHT. ...OZARK PLATEAU AND ARKLATEX INTO MID/LOWER MS VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON AND TONIGHT... THE LOWER BRANCH OF AN INDIRECT AGEOSTROPHIC CIRCULATION ASSOCIATED WITH THE MID/UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAK...AND MANIFEST AS A STEADILY STRENGTHENING LLJ...WILL ENHANCE THE NEWD FLUX OF AN INCREASINGLY MOIST AIR MASS FROM THE NWRN GULF OF MEXICO INTO THE OZARK PLATEAU AND LOWER MS VALLEY. THIS PROCESS WILL OCCUR BENEATH A SEWD-ADVANCING EML PLUME ORIGINATING OVER THE CNTRL ROCKIES TO YIELD A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON WITHIN THE PRE-FRONTAL WARM SECTOR WITH MLCAPE APPROAC

sections.title: MIDDLE AND LOWER MS VALLEY AREA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED MIDLEVEL TROUGH OVER THE CENTRAL/NRN PLAINS THIS MORNING WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE ESEWD WHILE GRADUALLY EVOLVING INTO A LARGE CLOSED LOW OVER THE UPPER MS VALLEY...AS THE ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE OCCLUDES OVER NRN MN. S OF THE CYCLONE...A COLD FRONT WILL SURGE EWD/SEWD FROM CENTRAL IA AND ERN KS THIS MORNING TO ROUGHLY A TXK-STL AXIS THIS EVENING AND THE LOWER MS/OH AND TN VALLEY REGIONS BY THURSDAY MORNING. LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING IS UNDERWAY IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT AS LOW-MID 60S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS SPREAD NEWD FROM ERN OK/NE TX TO SRN MO BY MID AFTERNOON...AND UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS COULD REACH AS FAR AS SE AR BY 21-00Z. THE DEGREE OF SURFACE HEATING IS IN QUESTION WITHIN THE MOIST AXIS FROM WRN AR INTO MO GIVEN THE PREVALENCE OF STRATUS THIS MORNING...AND THE EXPECTED EARLIER ONSET OF FRONTAL PRECIPITATION IN MO THIS AFTERNOON. SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRMS A BELT OF ASCENT FROM NRN OK TO ERN KS AND CENTRAL IA NEAR THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...AND IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF THE AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL TROUGH. THIS BELT OF ASCENT WILL SPREAD ESEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND PHASE WITH THE INCREASINGLY MOIST WARM SECTOR...WHICH WILL SUPPORT SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOP

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHWEST MISSOURI. THIS APPEARS TO BE WHERE AGEOSTROPHIC FORCING IN THE EXIT REGION OF A 70-90+ KT 500 MB JET...DIGGING SOUTHEAST OF THE CENTRAL ROCKIES THROUGH THE SOUTH CENTRAL PLAINS...IS ENHANCING LOW-LEVEL FRONTOGENETIC FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION IN THE PRESENCE OF WEAK DESTABILIZATION. THIS FORCING IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD EASTWARD INTO THE LOWER OHIO VALLEY...AND SOUTHWARD THROUGH THE OZARK PLATEAU...TENNESSEE AND LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEYS BY LATE EVENING...BEFORE WEAKENING OVERNIGHT. HIGHER TORNADO PROBABILITIES ACROSS EASTERN ARKANSAS AND THE MISSISSIPPI DELTA REGION ARE LARGELY CONTINGENT ON MORE SUBSTANTIVE BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION OCCURRING IN THE PRESENCE OF STRONGER PRE-FRONTAL LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION DEVELOPING EASTWARD THROUGH THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. IT IS INCREASINGLY UNCERTAIN WHETHER LIFT AND DESTABILIZATION WILL BECOME SUFFICIENT FOR SUBSTANTIVE DISCRETE PRE-FRONTAL STORM DEVELOPMENT NECESSARY TO SUPPORT THESE PROBABILITIES. HOWEVER...THE POTENTIAL FOR A STRONG TORNADO OR TWO IS NOT NEGLIGIBLE...AND IT SEEMS MOST PRUDENT TO MAINTAIN THE CUR

S OF THE CYCLONE...A COLD FRONT WILL SURGE EWD/SEWD FROM CENTRAL IA AND ERN KS THIS MORNING TO ROUGHLY A TXK-STL AXIS THIS EVENING AND THE LOWER MS/OH AND TN VALLEY REGIONS BY THURSDAY MORNING. LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING IS UNDERWAY IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT AS LOW-MID 60S BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS SPREAD NEWD FROM ERN OK/NE TX TO SRN MO BY MID AFTERNOON...AND UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS COULD REACH AS FAR AS SE AR BY 21-00Z. THE DEGREE OF SURFACE HEATING IS IN QUESTION WITHIN THE MOIST AXIS FROM WRN AR INTO MO GIVEN THE PREVALENCE OF STRATUS THIS MORNING...AND THE EXPECTED EARLIER ONSET OF FRONTAL PRECIPITATION IN MO THIS AFTERNOON. SATELLITE IMAGERY CONFIRMS A BELT OF ASCENT FROM NRN OK TO ERN KS AND CENTRAL IA NEAR THE SURFACE COLD FRONT...AND IMMEDIATELY IN ADVANCE OF THE AMPLIFYING MIDLEVEL TROUGH. THIS BELT OF ASCENT WILL SPREAD ESEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON AND PHASE WITH THE INCREASINGLY MOIST WARM SECTOR...WHICH WILL SUPPORT SURFACE-BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOP

sections.title: MIDWEST TO THE LOWER MS VALLEY/DEEP SOUTH
sections.text: EXTENSIVE PRE-FRONTAL BAND OF TSTMS FROM SRN IL TO S-CNTRL AR WILL BE THE PRIMARY CONCERN FOR SEVERE POTENTIAL TONIGHT. WITH MORE DISCRETE CONVECTION ON THE SRN PORTION OF THIS BAND...DEVELOPING WITHIN A MODERATELY BUOYANT AND VERY STRONGLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT...THE GREATEST THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE IN THE NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS SERN AR AND NERN LA INTO NWRN MS. HERE...ENLARGED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS WITH 30-35 KT 0-1 KM SHEAR WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR A COUPLE OF STRONG TORNADOES. LATER THIS EVENING...THE COLD FRONT SHOULD ACCELERATE EWD AND LIKELY OVERTAKE THE PRE-FRONTAL CONVECTIVE BAND. THIS SHOULD YIELD SSW EXPANSION OF TSTM DEVELOPMENT FARTHER INTO LA GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG PER 00Z SHV/LCH RAOBS. HOWEVER...STRONGER KINEMATIC FIELDS SHOULD REMAIN CENTERED N OF THE AR/LA BORDER LATITUDE. WITH AN INTENSE 700-500 MB JET PUNCHING EWD ACROSS THE MID-SOUTH BETWEEN 03-06Z...THE THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS SHOULD PEAK THIS EVENING. THE MOISTURE/INSTABILITY AXIS WILL CONTINUE TO PINCH OFF WITH NERN EXTENT ACROSS THE MIDWEST/OH VALLEY. FARTHER S...UPSTREAM PRESENCE OF 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS AMIDST ROBUST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ADVECTION...MAY YIELD WEAK BUOYANCY

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL THIS AFTERNOON. A WW IS NOT LIKELY ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY AT 1630Z SHOWS A BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS LIFTING N-NEWD ACROSS NERN MO. THIS ACTIVITY IS OCCURRING WITHIN A ZONE OF 850 MB MOISTURE ADVECTION...AND ABOVE A CLOUDY/STABLE SURFACE AIRMASS. THIS MOISTENING COMBINED WITH MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES FROM 7-7.5 C/KM IS AIDING IN A NWD EXPANSION OF MUCAPE VALUES NEAR 500-1000 J/KG. IN ADDITION...STRONG DEEP-LAYER SWLY FLOW AHEAD OF AN UPPER TROUGH OVER THE CNTRL PLAINS IS RESULTING IN 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AROUND 40 KT. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR ADDITIONAL CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER NERN MO AND CNTRL IL DURING THE AFTERNOON. A FEW MAY BECOME STRONG/SVR...AND POSE A RISK FOR ISOLATED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP FROM CNTRL MO SWWD INTO NRN AR THIS AFTERNOON. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR INCREASING THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS/MARGINALLY SVR HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO. WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MESOANALYSIS AT 17Z SHOWS AN AREA OF SURFACE LOW PRESSURE OVER ERN OK...WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING NEWD INTO NRN MO. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS THAT SOME CLEARING OF LOW-LEVEL STRATUS IS OCCURRING AHEAD OF THE FRONT FROM NWRN AR INTO S-CNTRL MO...WHICH IS AIDING IN TEMPERATURES WARMING INTO THE MID 60S. IN ADDITION...SURFACE DEWPOINTS ARE SLOWLY RISING INTO THE UPPER 50S TO LOW 60S. THIS SURFACE AIRMASS COMBINED WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000 J/KG OVER NRN AR TO AROUND 500 J/KG IN CNTRL MO. SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES A BAND OF FORCED ASCENT IS SPREADING EWD ACROSS ERN KS...AND IS LIKELY SUPPORTING THE RECENT INITIATION OF THUNDERSTORMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT. THESE STORMS ARE FORECAST TO ACCELERATE EWD ACROSS NRN AR AND SRN/CNTRL MO DURING THE AFTERNOON. GIVEN THE MARGINAL BUOYANCY...IT IS UNCERTAIN WHETHER STORMS WILL INTENSIFY TO SVR LEVELS. HOWEVER...STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT AND VERTICAL WIND SHEAR PROFILES MAY COMPENSATE...AND SUPPORT A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...MARGINALLY SVR HAIL...AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SHORT TERM MODEL TRENDS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST TSTMS WILL DEVELOP ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL TROUGH/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM NORTH CENTRAL-NERN AR TO SOUTH CENTRAL AR BETWEEN 22-23Z. ADDITIONAL STORMS SHOULD ALSO FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT AS IT REACHES CENTRAL AR LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. A MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER AND STRENGTHENING...VERTICALLY VEERING WINDS WILL SUPPORT A TORNADO THREAT...IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 18Z SOUNDINGS AT LZK/SHV BOTH INDICATED MOISTENING OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER BENEATH A CAP BASED AROUND 850 MB WHICH FOR NOW IS MAINTAINING SURFACE-BASED INHIBITION. ADDITIONAL MOISTURE RETURN INTO THE NRN EXTENT OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY COMBINED WITH SURFACE HEATING...WHICH HAS BEEN STRONGEST ACROSS SRN/ERN AR PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND SURFACE OBSERVATIONS...WILL FURTHER DESTABILIZE THE AIR MASS /MLCAPE APPROACHING 1000 J/KG OVER SRN-SERN AR LATE THIS AFTERNOON/. THE 18Z SOUNDINGS ALSO INDICATED 850-700 MB LAYER WINDS HAD BACKED SOME SINCE 12Z AND STRENGTHENED...WITH AN INCREASE IN WLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ALSO NOTED. THESE KINEMATICS ARE SUSTAINING LOW LEVEL HODOGRAPH CURVATURE WITH SURFACE-1 KM SHEAR AROUND 40 KT FOR A TORNADO THREAT AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-50 KT FOR STORM ORGANIZATION. UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN ABOUT THE DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION AND AMOUNT OF FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A DIGGING NWLY MID-UPPER LEVEL JET AND TROUGH TO SUPPORT TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. HOWEVER...TRENDS IN SHORT TERM MODELS /HRRR AND 12Z 4 KM WRF-NMM/NSSL/ CONTINUE TO SUGGEST FACTORS WILL BECOME JUXTAPOSED ACROSS CENTRAL AR BETWEEN 22-23Z...WITH ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE COLD FRONT BY EARLY EVENING ACROSS CENTRAL AR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LINE OF TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD ACROSS THE AREA. PRIMARY THREAT IS DAMAGING WINDS WITH SOME HAIL ALSO POSSIBLE. THE LINE HAS SHOWN A WEAKENING TREND...LEADING TO UNCERTAINTY REGARDING ITS SEVERE POTENTIAL AS IT CONTINUES EWD INTO A MORE STABLE AIR MASS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 23Z SURFACE ANALYSIS PLACES THE COLD FRONT ALONG A LINE FROM UNO NEWD TO ALN THEN NWD TO SFY...COINCIDENT WITH THE LINE OF TSTMS MOVING EWD ACROSS WRN IL AND SERN MO. IR SATELLITE SHOWS A WELL-DEFINED VORTICITY MAXIMUM ROTATING CYCLONICALLY ACROSS ERN MO INTO NWRN IL WITH ANOTHER STRONG VORTICITY MAXIMUM OVER ERN OK MOVING EWD INTO CNTRL AR. AS THE ERN MO VORT MAX ROTATES INTO NWRN IL...THE FRONTAL CIRCULATION ACROSS SERN MO/SWRN IL WILL LIKELY WEAKEN. RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THIS IS LIKELY BEGINNING WITH TSTMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT SHOWING A WEAKENING TREND. HOWEVER...LARGE-SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT TSTMS ALONG AND JUST AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. INTERACTION BETWEEN TSTMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND TSTM ACTIVITY AHEAD OF THE FRONT MAY RESULT IN CELL MERGERS AND LOCALIZED UPDRAFT ENHANCEMENT...RESULTING IN AN ELEVATED POTENTIAL FOR SVR GUSTS/HAIL. WATCH PROBABILITY FOR A DOWNSTREAM WW ACROSS CNTRL/E-CNTRL IL IS 40 PERCENT. MEAGER INSTABILITY AND UNCERTAINTY REGARDING CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION PRECLUDES A HIGHER PROBABILITY ATTM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SLOW INCREASE IN CONVECTION IS ONGOING ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...WHICH MAY REQUIRE WW ISSUANCE IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOW CU/CB DEVELOPMENT SWWD ACROSS SWRN AR INTO NWRN LA/E TX INVOF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT. AS THE MID-LEVEL JET STREAK CONTINUES DIVING SEWD TOWARD THIS AREA...INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WITHIN THE MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR SUGGESTS THAT DEVELOPMENT WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE WITH TIME. THIS FORECAST IS ALSO CONFIRMED BY HI-RES MODEL RUNS...EACH SHOWING SWWD DEVELOPMENT OF STORMS ALONG THE BOUNDARY THIS EVENING. ATTM...IT APPEARS THAT STORM MODE MAY BE AT LEAST TEMPORARILY OF A CELLULAR NATURE...WHICH -- GIVEN FAIRLY STRONG/WEAKLY VEERING FLOW IN LOWER LEVELS -- SUGGESTS SOME POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES ALONG WITH HAIL/WIND POTENTIAL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS PARTS OF WW 667.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP REVEALS SEVERAL ROTATING STORMS NOW MOVING ENEWD ACROSS ERN AND SRN AR...WITHIN FAVORABLY MOIST/UNSTABLE/SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. THE EVENING SHV /SHREVEPORT LA/ RAOB REVEALS A DEEP/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND OVER 2000 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE...ALONG WITH 0-1 KM SHEAR OF 28 KT. GIVEN THIS...POTENTIAL FOR A STRONG/LONGER-LIVED TORNADO REMAINS EVIDENT WITHIN THIS REGION. ..GOSS.. 10/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS NOW CROSSING THE MS VALLEY WILL LIKELY POSE DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL INTO THE TN VALLEY REGION. NEW WW WILL BE NEEDED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING STORMS ARE CROSSING THE MS RIVER ATTM...WITH EMBEDDED ROTATING CELLS ALONG THE LINE OF CONVECTION POSING TORNADO RISK ATTM. AS THE LINE OF STORMS MOVES INTO AN ENVIRONMENT FEATURING AN INCREASINGLY STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER...TORNADO THREAT WILL DIMINISH WITH ERN EXTENT. HOWEVER...GIVEN STRONG FORCING -- INDICATED BY PRONOUNCED PRESSURE RISE/FALL COUPLET ALONG AND JUST E OF THE MS VALLEY -- EXPECT ORGANIZED STORMS TO CONTINUE INTO THIS MORE STABLE AIRMASS...POSING A THREAT FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES ALONG WITH LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL CONTINUES...
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP REVEALS CONTINUED EWD PROGRESSION OF A BAND OF STORMS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT...WITH SEVERAL STORMS CONTINUING TO EXHIBIT LOW-LEVEL ROTATION. WHILE STORMS MOVING EWD ACROSS WRN TN HAVE SHOWN A TENDENCY TO WEAKEN A BIT...ISOLATED SEVERE/TORNADO POTENTIAL REMAINS. FARTHER S...WHERE A MORE FAVORABLY MOIST/UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT EXISTS...GREATER TORNADO POTENTIAL PERSISTS -- AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: BAND OF STORMS ADVANCING EWD INTO AL MAY REQUIRE NEW WW ISSUANCE...
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A BAND OF STORMS WITH EMBEDDED BOWS/LEWPS MARCHING EWD ACROSS NRN MS ATTM. THE DOWNSTREAM AIRMASS ACROSS AL INCLUDES A MUCH MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER...SUGGESTING THAT SEVERE POTENTIAL SHOULD SLOWLY DIMINISH WITH TIME AS STORMS BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED. STILL...GIVEN THE WELL-ORGANIZED NATURE OF THE LINE -- OWING TO THE VERY DYNAMIC MID-LEVEL SYSTEM...EXPECT SOME THREAT FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING GUSTS WILL LIKELY PERSIST FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE MORE HOURS. THUS...NEW WW MAY BE REQUIRED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THOUGH TORNADO THREAT IS SLOWLY DECREASING...ISOLATED POTENTIAL CONTINUES...
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP SHOWS AN OVERALL DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS...PARTICULARLY FROM NRN MS NWD WHERE STORMS HAVE EXITED THE MORE FAVORABLE ZONE OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE/INSTABILITY. STILL...WITH AN AMPLY MOIST/UNSTABLE PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY LAYER EVIDENT FROM CENTRAL MS SWWD...ISOLATED TORNADO POTENTIAL CONTINUES WITH A FEW STRONGER/ISOLATED CELLS. ONCE SUCH CELL -- NOW CROSSING INTO MADISON COUNTY MS -- HAS MAINTAINED LOW-LEVEL ROTATION...AND APPEARS TO BE THE MOST SUBSTANTIAL THREAT ATTM. EXPECT LIMITED TORNADO/SEVERE THREAT TO CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. ..GOSS.. 10/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR SEVERE AND POSSIBLE TORNADO THREAT TO DEVELOP INTO SWRN AL INTO THE EARLY MORNING. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE TORNADO WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS MORNING A WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM CNTRL THROUGH SERN MS. A MT TROPICAL AIRMASS IS IN PLACE WEST OF THIS BOUNDARY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE LOW 70S WITH 1500 J/KG MLCAPE. THETA-E ADVECTION ALONG SRN EXTENSION OF WSWLY LLJ WILL CONTRIBUTE TO EWD DESTABILIZATION INTO SWRN AL. STORMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE DEVELOPING SEWD NEXT FEW HOURS WITHIN BELT OF ASCENT ALONG WARM CONVEYOR BELT...BUT TENDENCY WILL BE FOR THE DEEPER FORCING TO GRADUALLY SHIFT NEWD AWAY FROM THE WARM SECTOR. A GRADUAL WEAKENING AND VEERING OF LOW LEVEL WINDS AND CORRESPONDING DECREASE IN 0-2 KM HODOGRAPHS SIZE WILL ALSO OCCUR AFTER 09Z AS LLJ GRADUALLY SHIFTS NEWD THROUGH THE TN AND OH VALLEYS IN ASSOCIATION WITH MIGRATORY UPPER JET EXIT REGION. IN THE MEANTIME AT LEAST A 4-5 HOUR WINDOW OF FAVORABLE SHEAR/INSTABILITY PARAMETER SPACE FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES MAY TRANSPIRE ACROSS A PORTION OF SWRN AL EARLY THIS MORNING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE EARLY THIS MORNING. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS OF 0600Z...A PRE-FRONTAL BAND OF TSTMS EXTENDED FROM TENSAS PARISH SWWD THROUGH RAPIDES AND VERNON PARISHES TO HARDIN COUNTY TX. SEMI-DISCRETE STORMS WITH MIDLEVEL ROTATION WERE OBSERVED WITHIN THIS BAND WITH A STORM MOTION OF 310/20 KT. AMBIENT...INFLOW AIR MASS REMAINS WARM AND QUITE MOIST AND MODIFICATION OF 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT MLCAPE REMAINS IN THE 1000-1500 J/KG RANGE. THIS COUPLED WITH AROUND 50 KT OF DEEP WNWLY SHEAR SUGGESTS THAT STORMS MAY PERSIST FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WHILE AN ISOLATED TORNADO REMAINS POSSIBLE...THE TENDENCY FOR LOW-LEVEL FLOW FIELDS TO GRADUALLY VEER AND DECELERATE WILL MITIGATE THIS THREAT WITH TIME. AS SUCH...DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD. ..MEAD.. 10/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT INCLUDING POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO MAY PERSIST THROUGH 10Z. HOWEVER...THE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN A GRADUAL DECREASE...AND ANOTHER WW WILL PROBABLY NOT BE NEEDED UNLESS TRENDS DICTATE OTHERWISE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF SCATTERED STORMS INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS WILL CONTINUE DEVELOPING SEWD INTO SRN LA...SERN MS AND SWRN AL NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...DEEPER FORCING FOR ASCENT AND TRAILING END OF THE LLJ WILL SHIFT NEWD AWAY FROM THE WARM SECTOR WITH TIME...RESULTING IN A GRADUAL DECREASE IN 0-3 KM HODOGRAPH SIZE. WHILE SHEAR/PARAMETER SPACE WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH A POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO NEXT COUPLE HOURS...THREAT IS NOT EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR A LONG ENOUGH DURATION TO WARRANT ANOTHER WW ISSUANCE.
